name: Denis Nesci - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on strengthening rural areas in the EU through cohesion policy
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for more EU cohesion money and attention for rural areas, where nearly one in three Europeans lives. It asks for a rural strategy for the period after 2027, better services such as healthcare, transport, internet and schools, and support for young people, women and small farms. It also wants less bureaucracy, help for areas hit by natural disasters, and a check that EU policies do not harm rural areas. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament asks the Commission for a rural strategy and a rural check on EU policies; no law changes yet.
- Rural residents, farmers, young people, women and small businesses would benefit if the requests are followed.
- Next, the Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests in future funding plans.
